versions.content: ISignal.receptionDefaultValue configured for SOME/IP Serializer "less data than expected received" The ISignal.receptionDe- faultValue (if defined) shall be used for the configuration of the SOME/IP Serializer "less data than expected received" (see [SWS_SomeIpXf_00017]) if: the ISignal references a DataTransformation in the role ISignal.dataTrans- formation and that DataTransformation refers to a TransformationTech- nology in the role DataTransformation.transformerChain that has the at- tribute TransformationTechnology.protocol set to the value "SOMEIP".
